description: This file manages legacy state migration for the 'matrix' extension in the openclaw project, including path resolution, migration planning, and automated migration with logging.

methods.name: resolveLegacyMatrixPaths
methods.description: Resolves the legacy matrix storage and crypto paths based on environment variables.

methods.name: resolveMatrixMigrationPlan
methods.description: Creates a migration plan for the legacy matrix state, returning target paths or warnings.

methods.name: detectLegacyMatrixState
methods.description: Detects the current legacy matrix state and returns a migration plan or warning.

methods.name: moveLegacyPath
methods.description: Moves a legacy path to a new location, handling errors and warnings.

methods.name: autoMigrateLegacyMatrixState
methods.description: Automatically migrates legacy matrix state, logs progress, and returns migration result.
